title: Update hero text to target worldwide learners

requirements.summary: Update hero subtitle to reflect worldwide audience instead of Indian learners exclusively
acceptanceCriteria: The targeted span element no longer references 'Indian learners' exclusively.
The updated text communicates that the course is open to learners worldwide.
No other content on the page is changed.

file_operations.description: Locate the subtitle/tagline span element in the hero section (second span child within the hero div) and replace text referencing 'Indian learners' with inclusive language such as 'learners worldwide' or 'students around the world'. Ensure only this specific span element is modified and no other hero content is changed.
